jobs.description:
Indian Tandoor Chef for Pippali Indian Grill

Pippali Indian Grill is looking for an experienced Indian Tandoor Chef to join our kitchen team.

Pippali Indian Grill is an Indian restaurant dedicated to serving authentic Indian cuisine with a strong focus on quality, flavour and traditional cooking techniques.

We are looking for a skilled, experienced and reliable Indian Tandoor Chef who specialises in traditional North Indian tandoori cooking, including preparing and cooking dishes in a clay tandoor oven.

As our new Tandoor Chef, you will be responsible for preparing authentic Indian tandoori specialities, including tandoori chicken, chicken tikka, seekh kebabs, naan, roti and other traditional vegetarian and non-vegetarian tandoori dishes. You will play an important role in maintaining the authenticity, consistency and high quality of our food.

Your main tasks will include:

• 
Preparing and cooking authentic North Indian tandoori dishes using a traditional clay tandoor oven

• 
Preparing and baking Indian breads, including naan, garlic naan, butter naan and tandoori roti

• 
Preparing traditional tandoori specialities such as chicken tikka, tandoori chicken, seekh kebabs, paneer tikka and other grilled dishes

• 
Preparing authentic Indian marinades, spice blends and seasoning mixtures

• 
Managing tandoor temperatures and ensuring proper cooking techniques

• 
Ensuring consistent food quality, flavour, texture and presentation

• 
Maintaining hygiene, food safety and cleanliness standards in the kitchen

• 
Assisting with daily kitchen preparation, ingredient handling and cleaning

• 
Cooperating with the kitchen team to ensure efficient service during busy periods

We expect that you:

• 
Have relevant culinary education or equivalent documented professional experience as a Tandoor Chef or Indian cook

• 
Have practical experience working with a traditional Indian clay tandoor oven, preferably in a professional Indian restaurant kitchen

• 
Have strong knowledge of authentic North Indian tandoori cuisine and traditional cooking methods

• 
Can independently prepare a wide range of tandoori dishes, kebabs and Indian breads

• 
Have experience preparing traditional marinades, spice blends and tandoori seasoning

• 
Understand tandoor temperature control, cooking times and proper food preparation techniques

• 
Can maintain consistent food quality and presentation in a busy restaurant environment

• 
Are reliable, flexible, quality-conscious and able to work both independently and as part of a team

• 
Understand and follow hygiene and food safety procedures

• 
Can communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not required.

Documentation of qualifications

Applicants should be able to document their professional qualifications and experience through relevant culinary certificates, employment references, recommendation letters, previous employment records or other documentation demonstrating education and/or practical experience as a Tandoor Chef.

Practical experience with traditional tandoor cooking and preparing authentic North Indian tandoori dishes will be particularly relevant.

We offer:

• 
A full-time position as an Indian Tandoor Chef

• 
The opportunity to specialise in authentic North Indian tandoori cuisine

• 
A professional restaurant kitchen with a focus on traditional cooking techniques and high-quality ingredients

• 
The opportunity to contribute your professional skills and culinary experience to Pippali Indian Grill

jobs.occupation: Academic Coordinator for the EUROfusion Project
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one funded Academic Staff position, to be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. The temporary position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, until 31 December 2027. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Work environment

The candidate will be part of SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development, and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently about 24 researchers, engineers and PhD students, specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

Job description

The candidate will be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. Jointly, and together with the rest of the team around this project, this goes for other institutes and departments of SDU TEK together with partners from ITER and EUROfusion. 

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have the following qualifications:

• 
Good communication and collaborative skills

• 
Good English and Danish skills, both written and spoken

• 
Can work independently and have a good overview

• 
IT skills and being good at developing and maintaining procedures

• 
Background in engineering will be useful, e.g. involving handling of 3D models

Contact information

For further information, please contact Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: November 30, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.description:
Do you enjoy solving complex product and data questions, helping customers get real value from a SaaS platform, and owning a case from start to finish? Then you might be the next addition to our Product Success Team at PriceShape.

At PriceShape, you’ll join an international SaaS company on a strong growth journey, where you’ll play a key role in making sure our existing customers succeed with our platform every day.

Your Role at PriceShape

As a Product Success Manager, you’ll support our existing customers and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) with product, data and technical questions. You’ll own every request from the moment it comes in until it is resolved or handed over with clear information and ownership.

Half of your time goes to product support: investigating issues, giving clear guidance and making sure each request reaches the right solution. The other half goes to commercial account handling: renewals, expansions, Business Reviews and spotting risks and opportunities in your accounts.

You’ll work closely with CSMs, Product Success colleagues, Solutions Engineers, Data Controllers, and our Product and Engineering teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

Product Success (approx. 50%)

• 
Handle product, data and technical questions from customers and CSMs with clarity, ownership and the right level of urgency.

• 
Investigate product configuration, product behaviour and data issues to find the cause and the right solution.

• 
Resolve requests on your own where you can, and work out whether a case is a product question, a data task or a product defect.

• 
Escalate complex data tasks to Data Controllers and product defects to Product or Engineering, with full context, examples and expected outcomes.

• 
Keep CSMs and customers updated on status, ownership and next steps.

• 
Turn recurring questions into better documentation, guidance and ways of working, and share insights with Product, Data and GTM.

Commercial Operations & Account Handling (approx. 50%)

Proactively manage contract renewals, expansion plans and account upgrades in line with the account strategy.

• 
Prepare and run Business Reviews that show product value, ROI and fit with the customer’s strategic goals.

•

• 
Document and escalate commercial risks and opportunities, such as churn threats or upsell potential seen in product usage.

• 
Experience in a customer-facing role within B2B SaaS, such as product support, customer success, technical account management or similar.

• 
A strong analytical and technical mindset, and comfort working with data and complex product setups.

• 
The ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and internal teams.

• 
Commercial awareness, with experience in, or a strong interest in, renewals, upsell and Business Reviews.

• 
A structured way of working with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.

• 
Fluent English, both written and spoken.

• 
The ability to thrive in a collaborative and international environment.

What We Offer

• 
A fast-growing SaaS company with opportunities for personal and professional development.

• 
A collaborative and international team with a strong team spirit.

• 
A competitive salary package.

• 
Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work-life balance.

• 
A modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C with great facilities, an in-house canteen, and social activities.

• 
Pension and health insurance.

About PriceShape

PriceShape is a global leader in competitor monitoring and dynamic pricing. Our platform helps brands and online retailers track vendors’ prices, stock availability and trends while implementing tailored pricing strategies.

We’re a diverse team of 80 employees from 24 nationalities, working from a modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C. We prioritise work-life balance, trust, community and personal and professional growth.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Scientist for formulation and high throughput assay development
jobs.description:
Do you want to apply your skills within drug discovery and help turn new molecules into new drug products? We are looking for a motivated Scientist to support our drug discovery pipeline within Pharmaceutical Development in our Biotech unit at Gubra.

As our new Scientist, you will take ownership for physicochemical characterization of peptides including development and maintenance of our high throughput plate-based assays. You will be part of both our Pharmaceutical Development department and our cross-departmental drug discovery project teams contributing to study planning and data interpretation to progress our molecules through the discovery and development pipeline. You will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians across Gubra.

Your new department

The Pharmaceutical Development department supports Gubra’s drug discovery & development projects by delivering physicochemical characterization, formulation development and analytical development and support for novel peptide drug candidates. Our department is involved all the way from early drug discovery, through to supporting Gubra’s CMC department when our projects go into clinical development. We are currently 5 scientists and 5 laboratory technicians in the department.

Key responsibilities

• Act as the Pharmaceutical Development lead scientist in drug discovery projects setting the scientific direction for designing, interpreting, and reporting studies from early drug discovery all the way to supporting clinical development.

• Responsible for setting up and developing new high-throughput plate-based assays to support discovery and development of new drug candidates.

• Evaluate physicochemical stability of peptides using high-throughput plate-based assays (fluorescence, UV, turbidity, DLS) and/or HPLC and MS.

• Drive early-stage formulation development for new drug candidates.

• Identify opportunities for automatization and optimization of our laboratory workflows and develop improvements in close collaboration with laboratory technicians and scientists.

Core competencies and qualifications

We imagine you have solid experience with and a strong interest in assay development for physicochemical characterization of peptides. You have knowledge and experience within early formulation development for peptides. You enjoy collaborating with laboratory technicians and scientists with different backgrounds and you thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• A PhD or master’s degree within biochemistry, chemistry, pharmaceutics, engineering, or similar.

• 3+ years relevant experience within drug discovery or development projects.

• Experience with different assay methods for peptides (fluorescence, UV, turbidity, DLS or others).

• Experience with coordination of laboratory tasks and close collaboration with laboratory technicians.

• Propose new scientific ideas, take initiative to move agreed work forward, and involve colleagues in developing and implementing improvements.

• Great execution and collaboration skills.

• Experience with communicating study plans, scientific findings and uncertainties clearly to scientists and laboratory technicians, adapting explanations to the audience and checking shared understanding.

As a person you are

• Keen to take on responsibility and take the lead.

• Proactive and good at initiating and delivering on new projects and following up on new ideas.

• Keen on collaborating across departmental workflows, sharing relevant knowledge and contributing to agreed priorities within your role and expertise.

• Able to adapt plans when priorities change, clarify expectations with colleagues and communicate the implications for ongoing work.

We offer

Gubra Biotech is a project-centric organization, and you will work in cross-functional teams on our drug discovery projects. As a Scientist representing Pharmaceutical Development, you will provide scientific recommendations within your discipline and agreed project priorities, working together with scientists from other study disciplines including Chemistry, Molecular Pharmacology, Translational Pharmacology, DMPK, and Computational Drug Discovery.

We are expanding our capabilities, and you will have the opportunity to impact what new methods and workflows that Pharmaceutical Development needs.

You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to take ownership and encouraged to share your ideas, learn from colleagues and drive projects forward while growing professionally.

Contact and application

Please apply no later than November 29th, 2026, by uploading your motivated cover letter, resume and relevant diplomas on our website. Applications will be evaluated on a rolling basis.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Senior Department Manager Natashia Mai Yde Jacobsen at nyj@gubra.dk.

We are looking forward to receiving your application.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialized in peptide-based drug discovery and development as well as preclinical contract research services striving for excellence at all levels. We insist on doing things efficiently – and often differently - to reach the results we aim for. Our vision is to become leaders in the path towards a more sustainable and healthier world. We do that by facilitating the discovery of new medicine, and by acting and inspiring others to fight the ongoing climate and biodiversity crises.

Gubra’s activities are focused on the early stages of drug development and are organised in two main highly synergistic business areas: Biotech and CRO Services. We generate our revenue by performing research for life science companies as well as by partnering projects from our discovery and development pipeline.

Our therapeutic focus is within metabolic and fibrotic diseases, and we specialize in in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, stereology and whole brain and organ imaging. In addition, we offer a full palette of advanced transcriptomics. Our ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform streaMLine enables us to rapidly develop a peptide hit into a non-clinical candidate ready for development. Through a constant focus on high quality, scientific excellence, speed, and solid teamwork we have established ourselves as a highly professional and competent partner in the market.

People are our greatest asset, and our team consists of around 300 employees of which many are located in Hørsholm, Denmark. The mix of people from different cultures and educational backgrounds combined with our entrepreneurial mindset have greatly impacted our working environment, which is characterized by entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity, and teamwork – we join forces!

**Your impact begins here

**As Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology, you will help build a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research that generates and validates therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. You will combine hands-on rodent pharmacology with original scientific thinking, shaping research questions and turning emerging biology into opportunities for drug discovery. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

**What You Will Bring

**You hold a PhD in pharmacology, physiology, neuroscience or a related discipline, or bring equivalent relevant research experience. You also bring:

• At least two years of relevant post-PhD experience with scientific innovation, or equivalent scientific contributions.

• Hands-on experience in rodent pharmacology.

• Strong skills in experimental design, quantitative analysis and interpretation of complex biological data.

• Scientific depth in metabolic physiology, neuroscience, in vitro pharmacology, or a related area.

• Original scientific thinking, intellectual curiosity and the ability to turn ideas into testable hypotheses.

• A collaborative approach and the ability to work independently while contributing to shared research goals.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Experience in metabolic phenotyping, advanced behavioural assays, rodent surgery, modern neuroscience methods, in vitro or ex vivo approaches, or developing novel experimental technologies. We welcome complementary profiles – you are not expected to bring expertise in every method or scientific area.

**What You Will Do

**You will contribute to both the scientific direction and hands-on experimental work of the team. Your responsibilities will include:

• Generate hypotheses and propose new therapeutic concepts grounded in biological understanding.

• Design, conduct, analyse and interpret mouse and rat pharmacology studies to investigate efficacy, mechanism of action and physiological responses.

• Develop experimental models and introduce methodologies that enable us to address challenging scientific questions.

• Connect in vivo findings with relevant in vitro and ex vivo experiments.

• Integrate evidence into recommendations on how emerging concepts should advance, change direction or be discontinued.

• Document and communicate findings, sharing scientific insights across disciplines and project teams.

• Contribute to rigorous, reproducible experimental practice and high standards of animal welfare.

All scientists are expected to contribute directly to experimental work alongside laboratory technicians and fellow scientists.

**Who You Will Work With

**You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. Day to day, you will work closely with scientists and laboratory technicians. The team, headed by Christoffer Clemmensen, is currently recruiting at multiple levels, so you contribute to shape the new team from the onset.

You are expected to establish close collaborations across the organisation with colleagues in chemistry, biology, DMPK and relevant technology functions to develop and test new therapeutic concepts. Bringing these perspectives together early helps the team make clear, evidence-based decisions at pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have the opportunity to shape the research of a new team and contribute your own ideas, in an environment that values thoughtful scientific challenge, collaboration and learning from unexpected findings.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn emerging biology into new therapeutic concepts, apply for the Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology role by 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Our platform supports more than one million production interactions every week.

• 
Models: frontier and open-weight models with reasoning, tool calling, structured output, and embeddings through an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus custom models trained and post-trained on an organization’s own data.

Sovereign compute: GPU capacity on Corti-operated European infrastructure for teams that need their data and workloads to stay in Europe.

• 
Agents: a harness to build, evaluate, and optimize agents that connect to real systems, with planning, tool use, external knowledge, persistent context, human approval, and observable execution.

• 
Speech: live dictation, conversational transcription, and batch audio processing.

• 
Clinical documentation: fact extraction as conversations unfold, and document generation with explicit schemas and controllable synthesis.

• 
Medical coding: code predictions from clinical narratives, linked to supporting passages.

Explore the platform at docs.corti.ai.

The Role

You want to train models at the frontier, and you want the science in the open, where other engineers can inspect it. At Corti, you don't have to choose.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in our Applied AI team, you drive large-scale training and post-training alongside researchers and engineers. Your decisions span the training recipe, the evaluation, and the system that serves the result. The calls are consequential, and you stay close enough to the implementation to understand why they succeed or fail.

What You Will Do

• 
Designing and running distributed training, including architecture, data pipelines, parallelism, checkpointing, evaluation, and recovery.

• 
Improving model capabilities through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and distillation.

• 
Finding the causes of unstable training, inefficient communication, poor utilization, and unexpected regressions.

• 
Developing models for agentic work: choosing tools, using evidence, maintaining context, and completing complex tasks reliably.

• 
Building evaluations that expose failure modes and establish whether an improvement holds outside the training distribution, including LLM-as-judge systems you build and calibrate

Creating and curating training data, including synthetic data pipelines that feed real training runs.

• 
Turning stronger models into practical APIs by improving latency, throughput, memory use, and serving cost.

Which capabilities belong in the weights, and which need tools or retrieval? You help decide, and you build the experiments that establish the answer.

Put the science where engineers can inspect it

We believe engineers should be able to examine the methods and evidence behind the systems they build on. We publish research, release benchmark resources, and document how our platform works. Read the work behind our clinical APIs: corti.ai/research

Who you are

You have depth and an urge to experiment

• 
You have trained large language models and owned technically complex ML work. You can explain a difficult run in detail: the architecture, the bottleneck, the failed hypothesis, and the evidence that changed your mind.

• 
You bring strong practical distributed-training experience, and depth in areas such as mixture-of-experts models, reinforcement learning, or distillation. Experience serving open-weight models is a plus. You write code other engineers can build on and make technical trade offs clear.
